name: Huellas En La Nieve (cube)
author: notlsa
description: Go above the triple spike and blue pad at 23% as the cube to stay at the floor. Jump on the very start of the block at 24.5% and then buffer one more jump. At 59%, you will move back into the level but as the cube. Avoid the certain slopes you need to by memorizing the shape, percentage or by looking at the algorithm in the videos thumbnail for when to jump.
